final: WITH s AS (SELECT t.equipstatus AS st, AVG(g.pulsepersec) AS a FROM signals g JOIN telescopes t ON g.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE g.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.equipstatus), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s), k1 AS (SELECT s.st, s.a FROM s, m1 WHERE s.a > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.st, k1.a FROM k1, m2 WHERE k1.a > m2.m) SELECT AVG(k2.a) AS avg_of_avgs, AVG(k2.a - m1.m) AS avg_excess_first_mean, AVG(k2.a - m2.m) AS avg_excess_second_mean FROM k2, m1, m2
